extra.reason: Skeleton compiles, clap CLI surface + identity/output/repo modules committed (d91a1c7).

lease.rs fully implemented (acquire/release/ls, atomic O_EXCL + write-temp-rename, TTL+grace, steal, re-entrant refresh) with 2 unit tests + 4 integration tests in tests/lease.rs, driving the real binary.
agents_md.rs fully implemented (managed_block/apply/ensure_gitignore/is_current), idempotent splice, 8 unit tests.

beads.rs (bd-only adapter) and msg.rs (send/inbox/read_thread over bd create --type=message + --parent/--assignee/--include-infra, per-agent read.json) implemented and smoke-tested end-to-end against a scratch bd db.
doctor command, README, CHANGELOG 0.1.0, and GitHub Actions CI (fmt/clippy/test on ubuntu+macos) added. Dogfooded pact's own lease + msg commands while writing this last batch of files.
pact 0.1.0 shipped: init/lease/msg/doctor implemented against bd, 21 tests green, clippy+fmt clean, README/CHANGELOG/CI in place. br compatibility deferred to a follow-up epic.

README rewritten with problem statement + 3 core-feature sections (onboarding/leases/messaging), each with a use-case scenario and mermaid sequence diagram. Added docs/architecture.md (system diagram, non-goals, exit codes), docs/leases.md (lease lifecycle state diagram), docs/messaging.md (message-to-Beads-issue mapping diagram).

pact ui shell implemented: ratatui 0.30 + bundled crossterm backend, panic-safe terminal restore, quits on q/Ctrl-C, verified it fails cleanly (no hang, no corrupted terminal) when there's no real tty. Committed 5978725.

Leases tab implemented: table of active+expired leases (path/holder/age/remaining/status/note), 1s auto-refresh + manual 'r', release-your-own is immediate, force-releasing someone else's requires a second confirm keypress. Verified with a real acquire/release round-trip via the compiled binary plus a TestBackend render test. Committed d310170.

Messages tab implemented: inbox list with unread marker, Enter opens full thread + marks read, Esc back, Tab key switches views. Degrades gracefully (Leases stays usable) when bd is missing or no agent identity is set. 10 tui tests incl. TestBackend renders for the bd-missing and thread-detail paths; re-verified the underlying msg CLI pipeline still works end to end against the earlier scratch bd db. Committed 72a24d5.

Extracted doctor::checks() shared by CLI + ui (pact doctor's own output verified unchanged). Doctor tab added as a real ratatui Tabs widget alongside Leases/Messages; Tab/Shift+Tab cycles, 1/2/3 jump directly, tab-aware help text. 34 tests total, clippy+fmt clean. Committed 3a5b7f5.
docs/tui.md added: purpose, mermaid state diagram of tab/thread flow, full per-tab keybindings tables. README gets a core-features entry + commands list + Learn More link. Committed 97542df.

pact ui v1 shipped: ratatui+crossterm dashboard with Leases (view/release), Messages (inbox/thread), and Doctor tabs, full tab navigation (Tab/Shift+Tab/1-2-3), 34 tests, clippy+fmt clean, docs/tui.md. Graceful degradation when bd or agent identity is missing.

Implemented via crossterm EnableMouseCapture/DisableMouseCapture, tab-bar and row hit-testing (equal-zone division for tabs, header-row+offset-aware for table/list rows), scroll wheel wired to existing move_selection methods. 6 new tests (40 total), clippy+fmt clean. docs/tui.md + README updated. Committed 3f0d246.

Replaced equal-zone tab_at() with tab_rects(): the exact per-tab Rects computed via a Layout with Constraint::Length per label (matching what render_header actually draws), shared by both rendering and hit-testing so they can't drift apart. Also added hover highlighting (tab bar + active list/table) via crossterm's existing any-motion mouse tracking, so users can see what a click will do before clicking. 8 new/rewritten tests (42 total), clippy+fmt clean, docs/tui.md updated. Committed 4791a14.

managed_block() rewritten: announce-intent-before-research directive with rationale, ownership rule + carve-out in one bullet, teaches lease renew / lease release --all / pact agents / pact whoami. ensure_gitignore() now manages the single line .pact/, idempotent against a pre-existing .pact/ and against the legacy pair. 9/9 agents_md tests pass, full suite 72+4 green.
